facts.title: Launch UI
facts.description: Carefully crafted components and templates built with React, Shadcn/ui and Tailwind that will help your product stand out from the crowd.

research.name: Launch UI
research.note: Landing page blocks and templates for React, shadcn/ui and Tailwind with a live theme switcher for color, radius and grid lines.

effects: Floating theme toolbar that shuffles color theme, border radius, light or dark mode and background line grid across the whole page
Hero mockup of tilted app screens lit by a colored radial glow

unverified: The free part of the source is public at github.com/launch-ui/launch-ui (MIT); that repository has not been researched in place of this site yet. Pro blocks and templates ($99 one-time) are not in it.
